## design considerations

* following `RESTful` principles
* do a graceful shutdown
* database agnoistic [Gorm](https://gorm.io/). For simplicity I am using sqlite, but it is configurable wit other databases easy using gorm.
* trigger an asynchronous background process that simulates sending a confirmation email 
* using standard libraries 
* local execution with `Docker`
* `Postman` as api testing platform

### API

```
    // --- Operational ------------------------------------------------------
	GET /healthz

	// --- Test support -----------------------------------------------------
	POST /api/v1/test/seed"
	POST /api/v1/test/reset"

    // --- Hotels -----------------------------------------------------------
	GET /api/v1/hotels
	GET /api/v1/hotels/{id}
	GET /api/v1/hotels/{id}/rooms
	GET /api/v1/hotels/{id}/availability

	// --- Bookings ---------------------------------------------------------
	POST /api/v1/bookings
	GET /api/v1/bookings/{reference}
```

more in [Hotel Booking API](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/1057860/2sBYHYtdBy)

### Concurency - confirmation email 

Done in `service\notifier.go`

### AI

Ai was used to generate: 
* postman tests
* `helper/refgenerator.go`
* `middleware` - this was not specified so generic one is a good start point
* doocker files 
* `writeJSON` in `handlers\errors.go`


### unit tests

Majority of the functionality is about the database and api, without proper mocking of the db unit tests are not possible to do. Mocking would require to write more generic code (using interfaces) which expands significantly the time of the development.
